'''Ronen Eldan''' ({{langx|he|רונן אלדן}}) is an Israeli mathematician, working at [[OpenAI]].<ref>{{Cite web |first1=Stephanie |last1=Palazzolo |first2=Kalley |last2=Huang |first3=Rocket |last3=Drew |first4=Aaron |last4=Holmes |first5=Jon |last5=Victor |title=20 Rising Stars at OpenAI and Its Rivals |url=https://www.theinformation.com/articles/20-rising-stars-at-openai-and-its-rivals |date=2025-03-10 |website=[[The Information (website)|The Information]] |url-access=subscription}}</ref> Previously, Eldan was a professor at the [[Weizmann Institute of Science]] working on [[probability theory]], [[mathematical analysis]], [[theoretical computer science]] and the theory of [[machine learning]].<ref>{{cite web |title=DR. RONEN ELDAN |url=https://www.weizmann.ac.il/pages/dr-ronen-eldan |publisher=[[Weizmann Institute of Science]] |access-date=11 February 2022}}</ref> He received the 2018 [[Erdős Prize]], the 2022 [[Blavatnik Award for Young Scientists]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ronen Eldan {{!}} Blavatnik Awards for Young Scientists |url=http://blavatnikawards.org/honorees/profile/ronen-eldan/ |access-date=2023-04-06 |website=blavatnikawards.org |language=en}}</ref> and the 2023 [[Breakthrough Prize in Mathematics|New Horizons Breakthrough Prize in Mathematics]].<ref name="new-horizons-breakthrough-prize-2023" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Breakthrough Prize – Mathematics Breakthrough Prize Laureates – Ronen Eldan |url=https://breakthroughprize.org/Laureates/3/L3931 |access-date=2023-04-06 |website=breakthroughprize.org |language=en}}</ref> He was a speaker at the 2022 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref name="jerusalem-post-february-2022">{{cite web |title=Three Israeli scientists win 2022 Blavatnik Award for Young Scientists |url=https://www.jpost.com/science/article-695949 |newspaper=[[The Jerusalem Post]] |access-date=11 February 2022 |date=9 February 2022}}</ref><ref name="New-York-Academy-of-Sciences">{{cite web |title=Prestigious Blavatnik Awards for Young Scientists in Israel Announces Its 2022 Laureates |url=https://www.nyas.org/press-releases/prestigious-blavatnik-awards-for-young-scientists-in-israel-announces-its-2022-laureates/ |publisher=[[New York Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=11 February 2022 |date=8 February 2022}}</ref>

== Selected works ==
* {{cite journal | last=Eldan | first=Ronen | title=A Polynomial Number of Random Points Does Not Determine the Volume of a Convex Body | journal=Discrete & Computational Geometry | publisher=Springer Science and Business Media LLC | volume=46 | issue=1 | date=19 February 2011 | issn=0179-5376 | doi=10.1007/s00454-011-9328-x | pages=29–47| arxiv=0903.2634 | s2cid=16096886 }}
* {{cite journal | last=Eldan | first=Ronen | title=Thin Shell Implies Spectral Gap Up to Polylog via a Stochastic Localization Scheme | journal=[[Geometric and Functional Analysis]]| publisher=Springer Science and Business Media LLC | volume=23 | issue=2 | date=22 March 2013 | issn=1016-443X | doi=10.1007/s00039-013-0214-y | pages=532–569| arxiv=1203.0893 | s2cid=253637768 }}
* {{cite journal | last=Eldan | first=Ronen | title=A two-sided estimate for the Gaussian noise stability deficit | journal=[[Inventiones Mathematicae]] | publisher=Springer Science and Business Media LLC | volume=201 | issue=2 | date=30 October 2014 | issn=0020-9910 | doi=10.1007/s00222-014-0556-6 | pages=561–624| arxiv=1307.2781 | s2cid=253737938 }}
* [[Sébastien Bubeck]], Ronen Eldan: “Multi-scale exploration of convex functions and bandit convex optimization”, 2015; [http://arxiv.org/abs/1507.06580 arXiv:1507.06580].
* Sébastien Bubeck, Ronen Eldan, Yin Tat Lee: “Kernel-based methods for bandit convex optimization”, 2016; [http://arxiv.org/abs/1607.03084 arXiv:1607.03084].
* {{cite journal | last1=Eldan | first1=Ronen | last2=Lee | first2=James R. | title=Regularization under diffusion and anticoncentration of the information content | journal=[[Duke Mathematical Journal]] | publisher=[[Duke University Press]] | volume=167 | issue=5 | date=1 April 2018 | issn=0012-7094 | doi=10.1215/00127094-2017-0048| arxiv=1410.3887 | s2cid=119657905 }}
